envelope.description: Route the content writers and the review paths through writeArtifact

body.title: Route the content writers and the review paths through writeArtifact
body.summary: Move the draft pair JSON writes in synthesize.ts and workflow-rpc.ts, resolve-comment.ts, provenance/writer.ts, the BUILD standalone-record.ts, review/resolve.ts (apply is content; accept, override and defer are meta-only), review/run-artifact.ts and review-step verdicts.ts (auto-fix is content; report-only is meta-only) onto writeArtifact, so each real body change mints a revision.
acceptanceChecks: A review that applies auto-fixes bumps the revision and a report-only review does not, through both verdicts.ts and run-artifact.ts.
Resolving a finding with apply bumps the revision and accept, override or defer do not.
A first draft written by synthesize or workflow.run has revision 1 and a re-draft keeps the whole prior tracker block.
The existing tests of these modules pass without edits.

tests.name: src/workflow/review/__tests__/review-revision.test.ts: auto-fix review and apply resolution bump the revision, report-only review and accept override defer do not, through run-artifact and resolve
src/daemon/steps/review-step/__tests__/verdicts-revision.test.ts: the verdicts path bumps the revision only when auto-fixes change the body
src/workflow/__tests__/draft-write-revision.test.ts: a first draft has revision 1 and a re-draft keeps the whole prior tracker block
